name: list-item
props: One muted line under the title.
Longer muted text, clamped to numberOfLines.
Small text at the end of the title row, e.g. a time.
Built-in glyph (user, bell, lock, shield, mail, card, help, logout, moon, globe, star, trash, settings, heart, phone, wifi) or your own, drawn in a rounded tile.
White glyph on a solid tile, or coloured glyph on a soft tile.
Round avatar with initials fallback and presence dot.
Muted value text on the right.
Dot, count (99+) or short label pill.
Disclosure chevron; on by default for pressable rows without trailing / checked.
Any control on the right, e.g. a Switch.
Makes the row pressable with a fading highlight.
44 / 52 / 68pt minimum height; icons and avatars scale.
Hairline that starts past the leading slot.
Check, badge and default tile colour.
Style for the row; ListGroup / ListSection apply theirs to their root view.
Uppercase heading and muted note around the inset card.
Draw the inset hairline under the last row too.
